QuestInfo.name: Flowers for Cassandra
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra just wants to go see the flowers when they are in full bloom on a warm spring day...
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate #r300 regular monsters#k within your level range so that Cassandra can go see the flowers. Make sure that the monster's level is not 11 or more levels below you, or 21 or more levels above you.\r\n\r\n#e#b(You'll lose 3 dice if you forfeit the quest.)#k#n
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra must be basking in a beautiful field of flowers right about now.
